decisive_items: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
multinucleated giant cells between necrotic tissue and viable inflammatory cells
response.rationale: History of RA on methotrexate/sulfasalazine with high-titer anti-CCP, leptomeningeal enhancement, and necrotizing granulomatous inflammation on biopsy favor rheumatoid meningitis; neurosarcoidosis is less supported by normal chest CT and RA-specific serology.

rejected.why: Oligoclonal bands correspond to serum rather than being CSF-specific, and the biopsy/leptomeningeal pattern is not typical of multiple sclerosis.
MRA is normal and biopsy explicitly shows no evidence of vasculitis; ANCA is negative.
